metadata.description: EvanFlow — a TDD-driven iterative feedback loop for software development with Claude Code. Vertical-slice TDD, parallel coder/overseer review, executable cohesion contracts, context compaction, no auto-commits.

plugins.name: evanflow
plugins.description: 16 skills (default loop + special-purpose + meta) + 2 custom subagents (evanflow-coder, evanflow-overseer) + git-guardrails PreToolUse hook. Single entry point: say 'let's evanflow this' to walk the whole loop end-to-end.
